name: turn_in_place
title: Turn in place ~90 deg by real footwork (no rope)
summary: The footwork step-turn: the G1 turns ~90 deg by REAL stepping (wtz=0, no crane yaw torque), shadowing a SOLVED-by-construction step-turn ghost (footstep plan + IK, COM kept over the stance foot). Needs foot torsional friction (OMNISIM_FOOT_TORSION) -- a flat foot at condim=3 freewheels and loses ~2/3 of the yaw. Because it is a slow WHOLE-BODY SEQUENCE (nb~225, 153-dim REF_OBS_WB obs) it CANNOT element-wise blend with the fast cyclic 120-dim family, so BATON runs it via a SOLO CONTEXT-SWAP (whole deploy runs it alone during a turn segment) instead of a blend.

ghost.notes: build_step_turn_ghost.py: footstep-planned + IK, COM-over-support (IK 0.3mm, COM-inside 54/54 single-support frames). A 180 ghost so a sustained turner learns steady-state turning and decel-stops at TURN_TO_DEG. Validator WARNs (turns are legitimately asymmetric).

baton.notes: solo_swap: _wr_turn_swap replaces every world._wr_* deploy field with the turner's context for the turn segment; blend + warm loop are skipped while in the turn; cold-hidden both ways. Continuous-turn + decel-stop (TURN_TO_DEG/TURN_DECEL_DEG) arrests the spin. Reliability is fragile in-sequence (the open wall).

train.notes: turnstep10: SEQ tracker on the 180 ghost, tight feedforward (GHOST_RESIDUAL=0.08, W_GHOST=26). Foot torsion MUST match train<->deploy. VERIFY frozen bundle; see docs/developer/step-turn-method.md + memory project_baton_policy_switching Rounds 10-11c.

verification.result: SOLO from a clean stand: turns ~86-90 deg CCW pure footwork (wtz=0), upright z~0.68, decel-holds. IN-SEQUENCE: SOLVED 2026-07-10 by TURN-LOOP (walk_turn_walk sequence: the 90-deg turner wr_turn90 replays partial passes of its modular 15-deg-staircase ghost until the ACTUAL heading reaches target, always finishing through the end-hold; TURN_HOLD_LOCK=0). Verified 3/3: 90.6-95.6 deg, 0 falls. The wr_stepturn/180 decel-stop path here remains the turn_solo config.
